title: Distribution
description: Stakeholder directive, in the context of Stakeholder directive: Kotlin library first, Rust library second; Stakeholder directive: transpile targets and API-first.

statements.label: Distribution
statements.requirement: The Kotlin library SHALL be published to Maven Central (JVM, Android AAR) and to npm (Kotlin/JS). The Rust library SHALL be published to crates.io, and its jco-transpiled WebAssembly component to npm. All coordinates are still to be chosen.

successCriteria.criterion: The Maven Central, npm and crates.io coordinates resolve to the released artefacts of each library.
